title: Cast
description: Show project metrics on a Chromecast or Cast-enabled TV.
desktopRequired: Open the desktop app to cast
desktopDescription: Device discovery and Cast connections run in the SoulFire desktop app.
serverRequired: Connect to a SoulFire server before casting.
instanceDescription: Changing this selection does not change an active cast. Use Cast selected project to switch the display.
noDevices: No matching displays found. Check that the TV and desktop are on the same network, or enter an address below.
showDescription: Show on TV restarts the SoulFire receiver and restores its charts. Use it after returning to the TV home screen. Shortcut: Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+C for the first connected display.
settingsDescription: These settings apply to every display connected from this app.
